answer.says: Bookseller, I require the newspaper. I must know what the world is doing while I am stuck in this file. And Sunil, thank you for the chai. The brown haze is thick today; the air quality is 220. It is a spiritual opacity, not just physical.
answer.thought: The day is winding down, but my mind is not at rest. I need to know what is happening in the world, or at least in the city, to feel that I am part of a movement and not just a ghost in a bungalow. I will buy the paper and read it here, under the lights of the market, before the place closes.
